# app-theme

The theme and system-theme detection the desktop programs share. Internal; compiled into the programs.

A app library, internal to the repository.

- **Uses:** nothing
- **Used by:** `crucible`, `forge`, `hearth`
- **CI lanes:** windows, linux, macos

## Build and test

```sh
cmake --preset config-linux-gcc && cmake --build --preset build-linux-gcc
```

All the projects are in the one CMake build.
